name: raise-sculpt
description: Raise sculpt tool (the default terrain tool): paint N sculpt strokes (hold A + drift LEFT stick to move the world cursor, release A to commit). The right stick only orbits the camera and never moves the cursor, so a right-stick drift cannot arm a stroke. No cycle needed (raise is index 0).
